selection: Fit each grid on train only. Choose minimum tuning episode-goal Brier; exact ties retain 12x8. Refit chosen grid on train+tuning. Calibration partition is not used.
zone_baseline: Smoothed immediate shot-goal reward with retained transitions removed.
smoothing: Joint categorical distribution over shot, loss, and each retained destination: total prior 10 centered on fitting-global category frequencies. Zone shot conversion prior 20 centered on fitting-global shot conversion.
eligibility: Periods 1-4; use normalized owner-only control episodes. Exclude whole episodes with an invalid required spatial coordinate; do not bridge missing states. Skip successful dribbles/recoveries/interceptions because they are not specified retained moves. Exclude episodes without an eligible modeled action.
terminal_rules: Shot, failed pass, incomplete dribble, dispossession or miscontrol terminates. Completed pass/carry continues. Every remaining episode ends with exactly one loss at its final retained destination. Rebounds/restarts/period ends are separated by foundation-v1 episodes. No double terminal.
test_policy: Premier League 2015/16 whole-date chronological holdout. All protocols frozen before evaluation; later model evaluations share the xG holdout and are not independent untouched tests.
interpretation: Value under the observed historical action policy; no tracking, defensive shape, optimal decision or causal interpretation. Shots receive xG in the app, never movement-xT credit.
test_disclosure: Premier League 2015/16 whole-date chronological holdout. All protocols frozen before evaluation; later model evaluations share the xG holdout and are not independent untouched tests.
